batch: P5 continuation: minimum 20 eligible nonduplicate January 2027 event instances
scope_notes: Events are named advertised themed programmes, not normal venue opening hours; all January date instances calculated from current official recurring weekly/monthly schedules and require reconfirmation nearer January.
Splash No Towels Saturday transitions to CumFest on the same first Saturday; one event record only, avoiding double-counting.
Yumbo ground-floor bar open all genders: only upstairs men-only sauna LET IT LOOSE included. Friday/Saturday downstairs cruise-bar nights deliberately excluded.
Nero mixed Biphoria Thursdays, T-Girl Tuesday and Kage last Sunday excluded; 1 January Naked Sauna Day withheld due New Year holiday uncertainty.
Dublin Leather Weekend January 22–24, 2027 is officially dated, but general programme is inclusive and no per-event male-only play space confirmed; recorded in audit as excluded candidate.
All 21 additions are recurrence-derived, not separate published 2027 dates; no future claim of exact separately published dates.
ClubZeus Sheffield first-Saturday CumFusion theme retained as venue research, but not added because the renovation/New Year operation needs reconfirmation.

source_rows.Name: Delmonica's
source_rows.january_findings: Official Delmonica's Glasgow is an all-gender inclusive queer drag/cocktail bar with a weekly drag entertainment rundown. No men-only darkroom event for January 2027; Winter Pride 28 Jan already in events.json and does not establish qualifying darkroom access.

source_rows.Name: Polo Lounge Glasgow
source_rows.january_findings: Official Polo Lounge Glasgow is explicitly LGBTQ+ inclusive, with pop/disco across several rooms and weekly club nights. No male-only playroom or January 2027 darkroom-special confirmed.

source_rows.Name: The Corset Club
source_rows.january_findings: The Corset Club website describes LGBTQIA+ cocktail lounge/show bar and ticketed entertainment, not men-only fetish play; no January 2027 eligible event verified.

source_rows.Name: Speakeasy Glasgow
source_rows.january_findings: Official Speakeasy homepage says the Speakeasy era has ended and is making way for Woody's Glasgow. Do not extrapolate events for closed/rebranded venue; no January 2027 announcement.

source_rows.Name: CC Blooms
source_rows.january_findings: CC Blooms Edinburgh describes an inclusive dancefloor, restaurant and LGBTQ+ nightlife. No confirmed men-only darkroom January 2027 event; existing January CC Blooms dates elsewhere in events.json do not change this audit finding.

source_rows.Name: Planet Bar Edinburgh
source_rows.january_findings: Planet Bar website shows an anti-bot verification screen in accessible content; no independently verified January 2027 men-only darkroom event.

source_rows.Name: The Street Edinburgh
source_rows.january_findings: The Street Edinburgh official page lists bar, eatery and nightclub hours with archive Festival 2025 and Pride 2026 images; no men's cruising/darkroom January 2027 event.

source_rows.Name: The Regent Bar
source_rows.january_findings: The Regent Edinburgh is an LGBT+ straight-friendly real-ale pub hosting Bear Scots second-Saturday meetups from 21:00; the social is at a pub without verified darkroom or men-only admission, so no event generated.

source_rows.Name: The Nightingale Club
source_rows.january_findings: Birmingham Nightingale is a large LGBTQIA+ inclusive dance/music club with no January 2027 men-only darkroom event found in the official site.

source_rows.Name: The Village Inn Birmingham
source_rows.january_findings: The Village Inn/Underground advertises drag acts and broad LGBTQ+ Friday and Saturday club nights; not confirmed male-only cruising with darkroom for January 2027.

source_rows.Name: Missing Bar Birmingham
source_rows.january_findings: Missing Bar Birmingham website explicitly welcomes everyone and promotes drag cabaret, karaoke and club nights; no men-only play party for January 2027 verified.

source_rows.Name: Equator Bar Birmingham
source_rows.january_findings: Equator Bar Birmingham is a gay-village social/cocktail bar; site has menus and events navigation but no qualifying January 2027 men-only darkroom date.

source_rows.Name: Glamorous Birmingham
source_rows.january_findings: Glamorous Birmingham publishes inclusive LGBTQIA+ nightclub entry and nightly opening hours, not men-only darkroom parties. No January 2027 qualifying special.

source_rows.Name: Yumbo Bar & Sauna
source_rows.january_findings: Yumbo Birmingham is an inclusive bar downstairs and separately men-only gay/bi sauna upstairs. Its LET IT LOOSE naked sauna session is listed Sundays from noon in venue/event guides; 5 January Sunday occurrences added. Friday/Saturday cruise-bar nights excluded because the bar itself is not men-only. January dates follow weekly rules, not individual January 2027 announcements. Official site and independent gay-sauna specialist used.

source_rows.Name: ClubZeus Sheffield
source_rows.january_findings: ClubZeus Sheffield is men's private-members sauna (photo ID needed); sauna renovation and Wednesday/Thursday closure ongoing. Official event card says CumFusion first Saturdays, while individual dated cards are November 2026. No January 2027 date specifically published; held out of this batch pending New Year/renovation confirmation.

source_rows.Name: Splash Spa Leicester
source_rows.january_findings: Splash Spa Leicester official men-only sauna with play/darkroom facilities: Tuesday No Towels naked day weekly, first Saturday No Towels then CumFest after 19:00 (one continuous event, not two), and FurFest second Saturday. Added Jan 2, 5, 9, 12, 19 and 26 (6 unique event dates). Source event archive is 2026 but recurrence rules are current; January 2027 individually not announced, verify holiday hours.

source_rows.Name: Nero's Sauna Bury
source_rows.january_findings: Nero's Bury official operating rules are men-only except named mixed Biphoria Thurs, T-Girl last Tue and Kage last Sun. Confirmed 4 January Friday Naked Sauna Days (Jan 8,15,22,29), 2 monthly bear socials (Jan 10 and Jan 30), and 4 Silver Daddies Wednesdays (Jan 6,13,20,27) from partner's weekly listing: 10 total recurring instances. Excluded Jan 1 because holiday scheduling not confirmed, mixed access events excluded. Neither individually dated January 2027 nor guaranteed without nearer check.
